copy.title: OpenAI puts agent reliability on buyer scorecards
copy.dek: Reliability moves from demo polish to procurement proof.
copy.take: Runtime reliability is the control plane, and buyers won't trust autonomy without it.
copy.why_now: The July 2 source trail ties OpenAI's reliability note to agent platform buying criteria.

OpenAI made runtime reliability visible to buyers, per OpenAI.

That changes the sales motion - until one sentence uses an em dash — and fails the gate.
